answer: Each agent registers an orchard plot, locking 60 credits. The epoch timber pool, fixed at 40,000, splits among verified plots. Each extra identity dilutes the pool, so fake gains fall as 1/N, a ripple reaching every fake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 85,000 (60,000 locked, filings at 25 each) chasing a 40,000 pool: a 45,000 loss. A rented-orchard ring reusing one timber record burns its bond. Honest keepers lock 60 once, keep full share.
